name: Marshall Islands: sole traders and small businesses

vatRates.note: Consumption Tax Act 2025 (P.L. 2025-47): applies to supplies and imports from 1 October 2026; registration from USD 300,000 of annual taxable supplies.

tests: Business carried on in the Marshall Islands pays the gross revenue tax or the net profit tax there; wages earned there pay wage and salary tax

calendar.note: Gross revenue tax: quarterly returns and payment by the last day of the month after each quarter (31 January, 30 April, 31 July and 31 October); the tax year ends on 30 September.

sources.title: Net Profit Tax Act 2025 (P.L. 2025-38), s. 38 and 40

workdays.note: Not verified whether deadlines here move off weekends and holidays. Kyros shows the last working day on or before the legal date, so paying on it is always in time, and keeps the reserve locked until the next working day after it.

presets.label: Gross revenue tax: 3% of revenue above USD 10,000 (business only in the Marshall Islands, under USD 300,000 a year, not registered for consumption tax)
Consumption tax 12% + net profit tax 16% (registered for consumption tax, or above USD 300,000 a year)

buckets.name: net_profit_tax
buckets.label: Net profit tax 16% (reserved on the whole base, a ceiling)

items.name: net_profit_tax
items.label: Net profit tax 16% on taxable income (Net Profit Tax Act 2025, s. 5), for tax years from 1 October 2026

calendar.note: Consumption tax: monthly returns and payment within 21 days after each month. Net profit tax: return and payment within three months after the tax year (31 December); quarterly instalments of the estimated tax are due by the last day of the month after the third, sixth, ninth and twelfth months of the tax year.

sources.title: Net Profit Tax Act 2025 (P.L. 2025-38), s. 38, 40 and 41

items.name: gross_revenue_tax
items.label: Gross revenue tax: USD 80 when annual gross revenue is USD 10,000 or less, 3% of the revenue above it (Net Profit Tax Act 2025, s. 6)

notes: From tax years starting on 1 October 2026 the Net Profit Tax Act 2025 replaces the gross revenue tax of the Income Tax Act 1989. A business carried on only in the Marshall Islands, with annual gross revenue under USD 300,000 and not registered for consumption tax, pays the gross revenue tax on revenue with no deduction for costs; it can apply to pay net profit tax (16%) instead. Everyone else pays net profit tax.
Consumption tax (12%) applies from 1 October 2026; registration is required from USD 300,000 of annual taxable supplies. Exports and services consumed outside the country are zero-rated.
Wage and salary tax on employees and social security contributions are not included.
The Marshall Islands use the US dollar. The government pays a universal basic income (ENRA) on Stellar in USDM1, a digital sovereign bond backed by US Treasuries, to the Lomalo wallet.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
